headline: Union unbeaten, Cercle winless: Sunday's gap in Brussels
summary: Union St. Gilloise are unbeaten in the Jupiler Pro League — fourth with 20 points — and on Sunday they host Cercle Brugge, who are 18th with 3 points and no win yet. Cercle have conceded 10 goals in their last five games, though they drew 1-1 in Brussels on their last visit. Union create 2.18 expected goals a game. The market makes Union 72.9% favourites, rates them 1.57 goals the stronger side, and sets the goal line at 3.25.
read: Union St. Gilloise are fourth and unbeaten after eight league games, and they host a Cercle Brugge side sitting 18th with three points and no win. The market makes Union a 72.9% favourite and rates the gap at about one and a half goals, with a high 3.25 goal line suggesting Cercle are still expected to score.

facts.fact: Cercle Brugge are bottom of the Jupiler Pro League — 18th of 18 with three points from eight games and no win yet (0W 3D 5L).
facts.meaning: They travel to the league's in-form home side still looking for a first league victory of the season.

facts.fact: Union St. Gilloise are 72.9% favourites to win, against Cercle Brugge's 11.0%.
facts.meaning: More likely than not — better than two games in three — the points stay in Brussels.

facts.fact: Union are fourth with 20 points from eight league games, unbeaten with six wins and two draws.
facts.meaning: They are the side with something to protect at the top, not a team scrapping for form.

facts.fact: Union are unbeaten in their last five in all competitions (WDDWW), scoring 10 and conceding 2.
facts.meaning: They come in on a run, although two of those five were draws rather than wins.

facts.fact: Union are averaging 2.18 xG per game over their last five, conceding 0.84.
facts.meaning: They create enough clear chances per game to support the market's view of a one-sided afternoon.

facts.fact: Cercle's last five read WLLDL, with their only win coming in the cup, and they have conceded 10 goals in that run.
facts.meaning: Their sole recent success came away from the league; domestically they keep conceding in bunches.

facts.fact: The market's 50/50 handicap line sits at Union -1.57 goals.
The market's 50/50 goal line is 3.25, with Over 3.25 at 49.3%.
facts.meaning: A high total next to a 1.5-goal favourite — the market expects Cercle to contribute goals, not just defend.

sources.fact: Union St. Gilloise had four wins from their last five matches across all competitions going into their Europa League tie with Real Sociedad, according to Goal.com.
Union St. Gilloise were missing 10 players for their Europa League clash with Real Sociedad.
David Hubert is Union St. Gilloise's coach.
A referee has been appointed for the Union St. Gilloise v Cercle Brugge match on matchday 9 of the Jupiler Pro League.
